ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, two concentric circles can be seen, the center O is marked with a black dot, and O is on the straight line AC; A and C lie on the large circle and AC is drawn as a straight line passing through the center, so AC is the diameter of the large circle. B is another point on the large circle, the line segment BC is a chord of the large circle, and it is tangent to the small circle. The problem gives the length of AB as 12. Let the radius of the large circle be R. The ratio of the radii of the two circles is 1:3, so the radius of the small circle is R/3. Because AC is the diameter of the large circle and B is on the large circle, by the inscribed angle theorem, triangle ABC is right-angled at B, that is, AB is perpendicular to BC. BC is tangent to the small circle, so the perpendicular distance from the center O to the straight line BC is equal to the radius of the small circle, R/3. Also because O is the midpoint of AC, and C is on the straight line BC, the perpendicular distance from A to the straight line BC is 2 times the distance from O to the straight line BC, that is, 2R/3. Now calculate the area of triangle ABC in two ways. Because AB is perpendicular to BC, and AB = 12, the area is (1/2)·12·BC = 6BC. On the other hand, taking BC as the base, the height from A to BC is 2R/3, so the area is (1/2)·BC·(2R/3) = RBC/3. Set the two areas equal: 6BC = RBC/3. Cancel BC to get 6 = R/3, therefore R = 18.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the large and small circles are concentric with center O on the drawn diameter AC; A and C are opposite endpoints of the large circle, B is another point on the large circle, and the chord BC is drawn tangent to the small circle. Let the big radius be R, so the small radius is R/3. Because AC is a diameter and B lies on the big circle, triangle ABC is right-angled at B. Since BC is tangent to the small circle, the perpendicular distance from O to line BC is R/3. As O is the midpoint of AC and C lies on line BC, the perpendicular distance from A to line BC is twice that, 2R/3. Compute the area of triangle ABC in two ways: using the perpendicular legs AB and BC gives area = (1/2)(12)(BC), while using base BC and height from A gives area = (1/2)(BC)(2R/3). Equate and cancel BC to get 6 = R/3, hence R = 18.

设大圆半径为 R。两圆半径比为 1:3，所以小圆半径为 R/3。因为 AC 是大圆直径，B 在大圆上，所以由圆周角定理，三角形 ABC 在 B 处是直角，即 AB 垂直 BC。

BC 与小圆相切，所以圆心 O 到直线 BC 的垂直距离等于小圆半径 R/3。又因为 O 是 AC 的中点，且 C 在直线 BC 上，所以 A 到直线 BC 的垂直距离是 O 到直线 BC 距离的 2 倍，即 2R/3。

现在用两种方式计算三角形 ABC 的面积。因为 AB 垂直 BC，且 AB = 12，所以面积为 (1/2)·12·BC = 6BC。另一方面，以 BC 为底，A 到 BC 的高为 2R/3，所以面积为 (1/2)·BC·(2R/3) = RBC/3。

令两种面积相等：6BC = RBC/3。消去 BC，得到 6 = R/3，因此 R = 18。
